title: Telnet: Support SSL in AUTHENTICATION option.
description:
When dissecting the AUTHENTICATION option subnegotiation, we currently assume
that everything is Kerberos 5.  Let's start honoring the authentication type
given in the request, and add support for dissecting an SSL negotiation too.

I could not locate authoritative documentation for Telnet's SSL authentication
type.  One reference is:

https://sources.debian.org/src/netkit-telnet-ssl/0.17.24%2B0.1-22/libtelnet/ssl.c/

While we're here, tidy up the strings of the "who" modifier.  RFC 2941
describes a bitmask containing these fields, but the interpretation of the
values have nothing to do with masking, so their descriptions should not
mention masking.

Tested with 1000 iterations of fuzz-test.
